text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a small runtime-only config tweak for chat-v2 routing/batching during late shift. No model binary changes. Canary 10% for 30m, then evaluate for ramp.

sam: Quick Qs — what exact params are we touching and which deployments are affected? hosted/dedicated/private?

maria: Change set: lower tenant_soft_limit from 200 -> 150 tokens, bump per-request timeout 3000ms -> 4500ms for the chat-v2 route. Also slight batch window increase to reduce tail. Affects hosted + dedicated routing policy only; private (VPC/on-prem) stays untouched.

leila: Please pin the rollout to the current model build so dedicated tenants don't mismatch. Suggest model_pin: chat-v2@2026-03-15. Also include a fail-open routing policy if canary errors spike.

maria: Agree — will add model_pin and a fail-open that routes to chat-v2-legacy on >1% error for 5m.

deploy-bot: Scheduling config deploy as requested by maria. Command queued: `/deploy-config --service=inference-routing --change=throttle-timeout-slim --canary=0.10 --duration=30m --pin=model:chat-v2@2026-03-15`

maria: Pushed the exact YAML to the canary bundle. Snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  route: chat-v2
  model_pin: "chat-v2@2026-03-15"
  per_request_timeout_ms: 4500
  tenant_soft_limit_tokens: 150
  batching:
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
    max_batch_size: 32
    batch_window_ms: 12
failover:
  on_error_pct: 1.0
  route_to: chat-v2-legacy
```

ken: Ran quick staging preflight (same bundle) — results: `200/200 OK`, p50=120ms (+60ms vs baseline), p95=320ms, errors=0.

staging-bot: [staging-preflight] 200/200 ok, p50=120ms, p95=320ms, errors=0

ops-oncall: Heads up — seeing memory spike on eu-west worker pool (~+18%). Can we hold the roll for ~15m while SRE investigates?

maria: Ok holding. Rescheduling by +15m. Thanks for flagging @ops-oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy window rescheduled. New canary start: 6162349900 (+15m). Canary params unchanged.

sam: What's the rollback plan if things regress? Want quick steps to revert.

leila: Rollback plan (short): 1) Pause canary (deploy-bot cancel) 2) Replace routing bundle with previous values (tenant_soft_limit=200, timeout=3000ms) 3) Unpin model if needed. Full runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-rollbacks

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6162349900 — 10% traffic. Monitoring hooks: latency/p95, error-rate, kv-cache hit ratio, token-usage-per-request. Auto-fail if error_rate > 1% for sliding 5m.

maria: Noting this in the release notes: https://redwood.internal/changes/6162349876-late-shift-throttle-slim

ken: Observing canary 10% for 10m — no error uptick. p50 ~+70ms, p95 stable. Token cost decreased ~8% in sample.

deploy-bot: Metrics snapshot (canary 10%, t+10m): errors=0.08%, p50=130ms, p95=340ms, token_cost_delta=-8%

maria: Proceeding to ramp to 50% in 10m assuming no regressions.

ops-oncall: eu-west memory spike resolved, safe to continue.

deploy-bot: Ramping to 50% now.

sam: Confirmed — no regressions in customer-facing errors across regions in the last 20m.

maria: Done ramp to 50%. Keeping on-call watch for 30m. Adding note to the release channel and tagging the canary metrics plot. :white_check_mark:

leila: Added small postmortem checklist in case of rollback (who does what, API keys, clients to notify).

maria: Thanks everyone. If nothing pops, we'll keep this in prod and include the item in tomorrow's release digest.

deploy-bot: Thread closed for this change at 6162349924 — config active at 50% (scheduled full roll later if metrics remain green)
